connection_condition: district.A3 groups districts: several district records share one region name
description: A region is composed of a set of districts; each district belongs to exactly one region, and a district record is meaningful only within its region grouping.
An account is held at a branch district; every account carries a branch reference and cannot exist without one.

connection_condition: client.district_id references district.district_id; the link is an indirect residence attribute rather than a containment of the client by the district
description: A client resides in a district. The client record carries a district reference, but a client is not a component of a district, so the connection is a business association rather than a part-of relationship.
An account is composed of its dispositions. Every account has exactly one disposition carrying the owner role and may have further dispositions for additional authorized users.
A client's account relationships are expressed through dispositions; every client has exactly one such record in this database.

connection_condition: every client identifier that owns an account is drawn from the set of client identifiers
description: An account holder is a client. The set of account holders is a subset of the set of clients, since only some clients hold an account.
A card is issued against a disposition of an account; a card cannot exist without the disposition it was issued for.
An account is composed of its transactions; the movement records have no meaning apart from the account they belong to.
Loan contracts are granted against an account and cannot exist without it.

connection_condition: running contracts are the subset of loan rows whose status denotes a running contract
description: A running loan contract is a loan contract. Running contracts form a strict subset of all loan contracts.

connection_condition: the highest card class is one of the values the card type column takes
description: A high-level card is a card type. The highest class is one of the classes a card can have, so its value set is a subset of the card type value set.

connection_condition: transactions performed with a card are the subset of transaction rows carrying the card withdrawal operation mode
description: A credit card transaction is a transaction. Card operations form a subset of the account transaction ledger.
Client age is derived from the client's birth date relative to a stated reference date. An earlier birth date corresponds to an older client.

connection_condition: the district's 1995 rate and 1996 rate supply the two inputs for the same district
description: The unemployment increment rate is computed from a district's unemployment rate at the start and the end of the period, expressing the change as a percentage of the starting rate.
The average salary gap is computed as the difference between the highest and the lowest district average salary within the selected set of districts.
The gender share of a client population is computed from the count of clients of the selected gender relative to the total count of clients in the same population.

connection_condition: account.district_id and district.district_id draw from the same district identifier value domain of 1 to 77
description: The branch of an account and the district master refer to the same district entity: the account-side reference records where the account is held, while the district record carries that district's name, region and statistics. The equivalence is documented so that a branch mentioned in one question is recognised as the same district referred to in another.
